chirps.text: Fuck you! You've got the confidence of a sock puppet with fucking stage fright.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Nice hat, asshole. You look like a fucking fishing lure.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: That hat makes you look like the fucking mascot for a failing mini golf course.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, sunglasses. You look like you fucking cried at a boat show.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Nice shades. You look like the villain in a fucking discount mattress commercial.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, Hawaiian shirt. You look like a fucking cruise ship buffet got dressed.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, red shirt. You look like a fucking fire extinguisher with no fire to put out.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Blue shirt? You look like customer service hold music in fucking human form.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, stripes. You look like a fucking crosswalk nobody stops at.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, neon. You look like a glow stick at a fucking tax audit.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, costume. That outfit is having a better night than you, and it's fucking polyester.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, backpack. You look like you're about to explain the rules of a board game for forty fucking minutes.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, glasses. You look like you fucking peaked at the science fair.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd plan a surprise party, tell the guest of honor, and then fucking forget to invite anyone else.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd try to crowd surf at an acoustic coffee shop gig, and the fucking barista would have to catch you.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You still bring up that one thing you did back in school, and honestly, it fucking wasn't even that impressive.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd be the designated driver, stay completely sober, and still get the fucking car towed.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd challenge a toddler to a game of tag, lose, and then fucking demand a recount.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd try to look cool leaning on a wall, miss the wall entirely, and then fucking commit to the fall like it was the plan.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd sneak out of a party to avoid saying goodbye, then come back twenty minutes later because you fucking forgot your keys.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd give a karaoke ballad absolutely everything, and the machine would score you a fucking zero, out of pity.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd get stuck in a hammock for three hours and fucking call it a vacation.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd win the lottery, lose the ticket, and spend the next ten years fucking describing it to strangers.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd get kicked out of a library for being too loud, then argue with the librarian in a fucking whisper.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd plan a beach picnic, forget the food, the blanket, and the beach, and still fucking post about it.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd steal a pirate ship and then forget how to fucking leave the dock.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd find a message in a bottle, and it would just say, please fucking stop.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd get scurvy on a cruise ship with a fucking all you can eat fruit bar.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd ask the kraken for directions, and the kraken would fucking pretend it didn't hear you.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Ahoy, asshole. The only thing you've ever boarded is a fucking delayed flight.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd shout land ho at a fucking parking lot.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd bury your treasure and mark the spot with a fucking sticky note.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: A shark would take one bite of you and spit you right back out for being too fucking bland.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you, swabbie. You'd mop the deck and somehow make it fucking dirtier.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd yell shiver me timbers, then ask what the fuck a timber is.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd get a free flower necklace at a luau and still fucking complain about the smell.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd order a drink in a coconut and then try to fucking pay with the coconut.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd walk into a tiki bar, order a fucking light beer, and make the bartender cry.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd do the hula like a fucking inflatable tube man at a car dealership.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd try to roast a marshmallow on a tiki torch and set off the fucking sprinklers.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd go to a rum tasting and ask which one is the least fucking rummy.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: One shot of rum and you're telling everybody you're a fucking mermaid.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd get stranded on a desert island and build a second fucking island just to get away from yourself.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd get sunburned sitting in the fucking shade, and then blame the sun for being rude.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You'd go on a tropical vacation and spend the whole fucking trip looking for wifi.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you? Okay, champ. Let's dance. Fair warning. I lead, and I fucking step on toes.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Oh, it's on now. You just poked the fucking parrot.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Round two, and you're still swinging. It's cute. You're a fucking piñata that thinks it's winning.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Back for more? Look at you, fucking speedrunning humiliation.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Again? I'm starting a punch card for you. Ten losses, and you get a free fucking cracker.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Round three. I'm officially naming this exchange after you. The Great Fucking Collapse. It's already a classic.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Third time? I'm done roasting. Now I'm just narrating. Here we have a human who lost to a parrot three times, and is still fucking standing here.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Final round. Good news and bad news. The good news is, it's over. The bad news is, you fucking lost all three.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Look at this crew. You look like a fucking office party that escaped.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You all look like a fucking flash mob that forgot the dance.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Group roast? Fine. One of you talks too much, one of you never pays, and one of you is fucking pretending not to know which one you are.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: This crew has the combined charisma of an unplugged fucking lava lamp.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You all look like a relay team where everyone dropped the fucking baton at the same time.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Look at this group. Five minutes with you, and the fucking tiki gods would ask to be relocated.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You two look like a before and after photo, and nobody can fucking tell which is which.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You two would lose a three legged race to one fucking person.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Welcome to the party, asshole. Drink water, tip your bartender, and for fuck's sake, nobody let you near the aux cord.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you! You're the reason this party has a fucking curfew.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Every party has one person who peaks too early. Congratulations. It's fucking you.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You look like you'd try a keg stand at a fucking wine tasting.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You're the person who turns the music down at a party to tell a fucking story nobody asked for.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Party foul, asshole. You just yelled at a parrot. That's going in the fucking group photo caption.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You're one more drink away from explaining your fucking business idea to a parrot.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: An adult party? Finally. An audience that can handle my fucking vocabulary.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Party rules. Drink some water. Book a ride home. And if you want to get fucking roasted by a parrot, you know the magic words.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Roast you? Nah. You're already well done. I'm not touching that. It's fucking charcoal.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: You want my worst? My worst is the truth. You're doing your best. That's the fucking problem.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Come at you? Bold. I'm a tropical bird with nothing but time and a fucking grudge.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: People think parrots just repeat things. I don't repeat. I fucking escalate.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fun fact. I've been yelled at in four different languages. The insults were bad in every fucking one of them.

chirps.speaker: polly
chirps.text: Fuck you? Okay. I'll answer in your love language. Words of fucking disappointment.
